flow.stepDescription: Wait for Kokomi near the Sangonomiya Shrine

dialogs.text: Huh? Kokomi isn't here yet...
That's weird. She doesn't seem like the type to show up late to things... Eh, let's wait a while longer.
How is she still not here? Do you think she could be in trouble?
Let's go ask that soldier over there.
Are you looking for Her Excellency?
I'm afraid she isn't here at the moment. I don't know where she's gone.
So strange... Guess we should just call it a rain check then?
Not necessarily. If I recall correctly, Her Excellency has made special provisions for just such a scenario in her General Operational Directives.

Let me see... Ah yes, No. 98. <color=#00E1FFFF> "Should a visitor from afar come to see me, and should my whereabouts be unknown, direct them to proceed southward until they arrive at a tree with purple foliage."</color>

The footnote stipulates that this only applies when Her Excellency has made no communication regarding her whereabouts before disappearing, and even then only when the visitor in question is of VIP status.
As far as I'm concerned, you two tick all of the boxes. I keep this directive on me at all times — I'm sure this is the right course of action.
Kokomi really does think of everything! Alright, let's find the place she wrote about and have a look.
Kokomi!
So this is where you ran off to! We were gonna meet up and get things ready for the Victory Feast today, what happened?
Oh... It's you...
I—I apologize... I'm not feeling my usual self today.
*gasp* You got sick? We'll go find a doctor right away!
No no, it's nothing like that... It's just, my energy is completely spent.
Y—You run on energy? *gasp* You mean... you're like a Ruin Guard!?
No, it's just a figure of speech. *sigh* I'm ashamed to admit it, but I can't always be the infinitely capable person I present myself as.
Everyone was asking so much of you yesterday...
Oh... you noticed? I guess I haven't quite mastered the ability to hide how I'm feeling. I'll keep working at it...
To be honest, I'm not really cut out to be a leader. At first, my dream was to read up on military strategy and perhaps become an adviser.
Constantly communicating with people, trying to retain their morale, having to read between the lines, making sure everyone gets the recognition they deserve... It's such hard work.

You're somehow supposed to make people feel wonderful just from being in your presence, while also commanding their respect... It doesn't come naturally to me. Truth be told, it's something I never wanted for myself.
But because of my bloodline, I was always going to end up being the Divine Priestess sooner or later. Like it or not, it's just the way it is.
So whenever I feel overwhelmed, I come here to just lose myself in a book and relax for a while...
Don't worry, it doesn't affect my work. I handed over preparations for the Victory Feast to someone else.
I have to make a speech tonight, and I mustn't give the troops any reason to suspect that something could be wrong. This peace was hard-won, and I want them to feel at ease.
Is there anything we can do to help?

I should be feeling energized again soon if I hold off on work for a little longer. *sigh* If only there were some way I could listen to a good read on military strategy, I'm sure that'd speed up the process...
I was reading a book last time I was here, but I only got about halfway through. Where did I put it...
We'll find it for you!
And then we'll read it out to you — to help you recover!
You'd do that for me? Thank you.
Hehe... I'm really lucky you came back to Watatsumi Island.
I could sense things were getting to you.
Ahh... I don't even want to move right now.
It'd be so nice if all my work could just do itself without me having to lift a finger...
I'm actually pretty social when I have the energy.
Still, talking to people I don't know is really draining...
Whoa... Look at all these petitions.
So does Kokomi make time to deal with these even when she's resting?
"Sangonomiya Events Cash Flow Statement," "Consolidated Annual Report on Fishing Production," "Watatsumi Island Monthly Maintenance Expenses Breakdown"...
This is a lot of work for one person. And it's on top of all the directives she has to write and the people she has to meet day-to-day. It's no wonder she gets burnt out from time to time.
Let's track down that book and help her feel like herself again!
Ahh... I don't even want to move right now.
It'd be so nice if all my work could just do itself without me having to lift a finger...
I'm actually pretty social when I have the energy.
Still, talking to people I don't know is really draining...
#Hey, look, {NICKNAME}. Could this be the book she wanted?
"Swordfish captain came back today. Energy +4..."
Ah, that's... that's just, um...
We saw nothing.
Give. It. Here.
Eh-heh, guess that was the wrong one... Let's keep looking.
(And if we did, it was all Paimon's fault.)
...You saw it, didn't you?
#It's gotta be this one, right, {NICKNAME}?
Look, there's even a bookmark. None of the other books have one, so she must have finished reading those already.
Whew, it's pretty dense. Paimon doesn't understand a thing...
Well, let's take it over and read it to her!

flow.stepDescription: Read a book about military strategy to Kokomi

dialogs.text: Kokomi, is this the book you wanted?
Hmm, I'm not sure, actually... Could you read a bit out loud?
"Act to the plan, and plan to the situation"...
*yawns* Yes, that's the one! Thank you.
Kokomi? Kokomi...
#Oh no, she's fallen asleep. What're we gonna do, {NICKNAME}?
Tonight's the Victory Feast! Not to mention that the peace talks are just around the corner. She's got so much to do...
Let's let her rest a while.
You sure that's a good idea?
Hmm, she does look pretty exhausted. Guess there's still some time to go, too. Alright, let's keep her company while she rests.
Avoid disaster... Protect peace at all costs...
The war's over... Things are slowly getting better...
Did you see...?
Uhhhh... Huh? What time is it? Did I fall asleep?
Yup, you've been out for ages! It's nearly time for the feast!
I can't believe it got so late!
*sigh* I haven't slept that peacefully in so long. That's gotta be three whole energy points right there. Should be enough to see me through the peace talks.
#Thank you, {NICKNAME}. Well, we better get ourselves over there, it's nearly time to light the bonfire.
Woohoo, Kokomi's back to full energy! Good to have you back!
Let's wake her up.
We probably should, after all, she did say she wanted to wrap everything up before the feast kicks off!
Kokomi, wakey-wakey!
Hmmmm...? Was I asleep? ...What time is it?
Time to get going! It's nearly time for the feast!
Really? It's that time already? Ughhhh... I still don't feel like I'm fully recharged.
I'll buy you a new book on military strategy.
Really? Yes! I want the latest volume of the Teyvat Art of War!
The Yae Publishing House published it last month, but I haven't had the chance to get my hands on it... No backing out now, okay?
Huh, that really perked her up.
Alright, let's get to the feast!
"Attack where the enemy is weak, emerge where the enemy is blind"...
